final: WITH fee_net_rates AS (SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, feerate - rebrate AS net_fee_rate FROM fees), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS benchmark_rate FROM fee_net_rates), order_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fee_net_rates GROUP BY orderslink), above_benchmark AS (SELECT orderslink, avg_rebtotal, avg_net_fee_rate, avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_rate AS excess FROM order_stats, benchmark WHERE avg_net_fee_rate > benchmark_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotals, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_of_avg_net_fee_rates, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM above_benchmark
